description: Separate virtual-only strategy accounts. The three EMA50/MACD/RSI 4H strategies run in an isolated simulator. Their stop anchor is provisionally signal-candle close because the original anchor was not recovered. EMA200+ADX remains inactive until exact rules are recovered. RSI70 cross-down SHORT 1H BTC/BNB/XRP candidates run in a separate isolated simulator with separate accounts; stop anchor remains provisional.

strategies.name: XRP SHORT 4H

historical_reference.note: Metrics supplied by user from recovered historical notes; original trade log/script not yet found.

signal_conditions: RSI(14) between 32 and 50 inclusive (exact boundary convention to be verified)
recovered_rules.entry: Open of the next 4H candle after the qualifying candle closes
recovered_rules.stop_loss: 1.5 * ATR(14) from signal-candle close (provisional simulator convention; original anchor not recovered)
recovered_rules.take_profit: 2R from actual next-candle entry using the resulting entry-to-stop distance
recovered_rules.validation_split: First 2/3 and final 1/3; exact split timestamp to be recovered
